description: The chart illustrates the number of hateful communication datasets per year, separated into “Untargeted” and “Targeted” categories. The horizontal axis lists years in ascending order from 2012 through 2022 (labeled “Year”), and the vertical axis is labeled “Number of datasets” with a linear scale and tick marks shown at regular intervals (approximately every 20 units) from 0 up to about 160. For each year, a single stacked vertical bar is shown, with the lower segment in blue representing “Untargeted” and the upper segment in orange representing “Targeted,” as indicated by the legend titled “Targets” in the upper-left. Early years (2012–2015) have very short stacks near zero, with small blue and/or orange segments; mid years show moderate totals (e.g., around 2017 roughly near 60 total, 2018 near 90, and 2019 near 110) with both blue and orange portions visible. The tallest stacked bars occur around 2020 and 2021, reaching roughly the 160 range, with substantial contributions from both blue and orange segments; 2022 shows a shorter stack around the 100 range. The bars are not visually emphasized with outlines or annotations beyond the color coding and stacking, and the ordering follows chronological year order rather than sorting by bar height.
